correctness.rationale: Proof starts from the correct quiver multiplication, uniquely decomposes each two-sided ideal by its semisimple vertex support and all Peirce corner subspaces, explicitly computes IK and imposes S∩T=∅, then derives every one of the nine edge weights. The independent script enumerates all original two-sided ideals and ordered products for finite cases; the all-quiver statement is proved, not inferred from finite checks.

value.rationale: The ordered dimension-refined annihilating-ideal product is a natural invariant of a finite algebra and its directed ideal graph. The formula covers every finite quiver and finite field with a constant three-state local transfer weight per occupied arrow block. A three-vertex fork has the same individual ideal dimension polynomial as its opposite yet distinct directed ideal-pair statistics, proving that the bivariate census captures information the usual ideal polynomial misses.
